_comment: The standard production-readiness checklist every web app shares (Google SRE Production Readiness Review + the four golden signals, per system). PERMANENT and 100% OWNED (Reif 2026-09-24: 'keep that list, and have an agent on every one of those things'): every item names exactly one EXISTING member as `owner`, the `check` that member runs, and `cadence_h`, the longest the check may go without running. scripts/coverage_map.py (librarian, daily) FAILS if an item has no owner, its owner is not a live member, or the owner's check has not run within cadence_h -- measured from the owner's last run in fleet.db, or from the mtime of `evidence` (a file under $FLEET_LOG_DIR the deterministic check writes). `needs` = the inventory kind that makes an item applicable (n/a when absent; still owned). Add an item when a new class of failure is found by hand; never delete one to make the map green, never add a member to own one.

items.item: request latency (p50/p95) per service, against a budget
items.check: journey_walker: time every journey step; a step over 3s on desktop or 5s on mobile is a finding

items.item: traffic volume per service, with a drop alarm
items.check: read the ga4 inflow (sessions_today vs the 7-day mean from /990/api/signals/ga4); a >50% drop is a breach

items.item: error rate / user-facing breakage per service
items.check: journey_walker walks every journey every pass; a 5xx, blank page or console error is a filed finding

items.item: saturation: pool, CPU, connection headroom
items.check: prod_runtime.py box-saturation + pg connection share (every 3h, deterministic)

items.item: slow queries: pg_stat_statements top-N by total and max time
items.check: prod_runtime.py pg_statements_total/max (every 3h)

items.item: index misses: sequential scans on big tables
items.check: prod_runtime.py pg_seqscan on tables over 1M rows (every 3h)

items.item: connections vs max_connections, pool sizing, idle-in-transaction
items.check: prod_runtime.py pg_conn vs max_connections (every 3h)

items.item: statement_timeout / idle timeouts set per role
items.check: prod_runtime.py pg_settings + pg_role_settings statement/idle timeouts (every 3h)

items.item: lock waits and long-running transactions
items.check: prod_runtime.py pg_locks + pg_long (every 3h)

items.item: app uses a least-privilege role, not the admin role
items.check: prod_runtime.py pg_role_settings: app role is not a superuser/createrole role (every 3h)

items.item: backups/PITR exist AND a restore has been tested recently
items.check: prod-runtime pass: DO API lists atlas-pg backups (newest < 26h) and the last restore test date; no test in 90 days is a finding

items.item: CPU load, memory, disk per host
items.check: prod_runtime.py box section: load/mem/disk (every 3h)

items.item: error rate in system/app logs
items.check: prod_runtime.py journal: error-priority lines per unit (every 3h)

items.item: service crash/restart counts
items.check: prod_runtime.py restarts: NRestarts per app unit (every 3h)

items.item: edge 5xx rate
items.check: prod-runtime pass: Cloudflare GraphQL httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups edge 5xx share over 24h

items.item: WAF challenges hitting real users or monitors
items.check: journey_walker from outside the edge: a WAF challenge page on any journey is a finding

items.item: cache hit rate
items.check: prod-runtime pass: Cloudflare GraphQL cache status share over 24h; below 50% on static paths is a finding

items.item: every scheduled job's last exit code and failure count
items.check: prod_runtime.py cron-failures from cron_exits (every 3h)

items.item: deadman: a job that stopped running at all is noticed
items.check: prod-runtime pass: every installed cron in the capture with no EXIT line within 2x its schedule (the box fleet_auditor log names them) is a finding

items.item: data ingests fresh (last success within their cadence)
items.check: prod_runtime.py ingest-freshness on the ingest crons (every 3h)

items.item: deploy success rate
items.check: every pass: the last deploys' outcome from the deploy log; a failed deploy is fixed or reverted

items.item: one-command rollback exists and a bad deploy gets reverted
items.check: a deploy that breaks prod is reverted with git revert + redeploy inside the same pass

items.item: OWASP top 10 exercised against the live app
items.check: OWASP top-10 probes against the live app

items.item: injection/unsafe-SQL lint on every change
items.check: grep the product repo diff since the last pass for f-string/format SQL and unparameterised execute(); each is a finding

items.item: secrets scan of the product repo and deploys
items.check: scan the product repo diff since the last pass for credential shapes (the librarian-scrub classes); the box maint_secret_scan log is read too

items.item: dependency CVE scan
items.check: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/alerts?state=open: every high/critical alert older than 7 days is a finding

items.item: TLS certificate expiry
items.check: openssl s_client -connect <domain>:443 | openssl x509 -enddate: under 14 days left is a finding

items.item: DNS records drift / takeover risk
items.check: dig NS/A/AAAA/CNAME/MX for the domain and its subdomains: a CNAME to an unclaimed host or a record change since the last pass is a finding

items.item: SPF / DKIM / DMARC valid
items.check: dig TXT for SPF, _dmarc and the resend DKIM selector: missing or p=none is a finding

items.item: bounce and complaint rate
items.check: read the email-bounces inflow (dash_events mailer bounced/complained): hard-bounce share of sends over 2% is a finding

items.item: analytics events (GA4/PostHog) still flowing
items.check: read the ga4/posthog/clarity inflows in the daily inflows table; a non-OK one is a finding

items.item: Search Console indexation / coverage
items.check: read the gsc inflow (/990/api/signals/gsc coverage + gsc_performance cron): indexed pages falling week over week is a finding

items.item: payment webhooks delivered and processed
items.check: read the stripe-webhooks inflow (stripe_webhook_events newest row) against Stripe's own event list

items.item: failed charges / disputes
items.check: Stripe API charges?status=failed and disputes over the last 7 days; any unexplained one is a finding

items.item: infra + third-party spend vs budget
items.check: the box spend_limits_check log + DO invoice preview vs budget

items.item: API quotas (GSC, PostHog, LLM accounts) vs limits
items.check: GSC/PostHog/LLM account quota reads (posthog billing, maxx budget) vs limits

items.item: every data source in docs/data_inflows.json delivered within its freshness window, credential present
items.check: coverage_map.py inflows table (first section of the daily HQ line); any non-OK inflow fails the audit
